gary_2026_08_24_the_shortlist_founder_sh.title: The Shortlist Founder Showcase
gary_2026_08_24_the_shortlist_founder_sh.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_08_24_the_shortlist_founder_sh.summary: Gary's Guide: The Shortlist NYC - August Founder Showcase (#8) The Shortlist is back for our monthly Founder Showcase & the room keeps getting better. This is a monthly curated, application-only evening connecting early-stage founders with exceptional operators across New York. No panels. No pitches to VCs. Just six founders building breakout companies, a room full of people who've built things themselves, & the kind of candid conversation you don't get at most events. Each founder will share what they're building, why it matters, & the specific roles they're actively hiring for right now - followed by a mixer. What to expect: Founders presenting at the seed through Series B stage. Operators, builders, & executives who've seen what good looks like. An intentionally small room designed for real connection. Who this is for: Exceptional operators - whether you're actively exploring your next role, casually curious, or simply want to stay close to what's being built in NYC right now. Founders will be announced in the days leading up to the event. Attendance is intentionally limited. Apply to be considered. More information on The Shortlist can be found here. Founded by Andrew Yeung & Ivor Straford.

gary_2026_08_24_acelab_x_structured_ai_h.title: Acelab x Structured AI Hackathon
gary_2026_08_24_acelab_x_structured_ai_h.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_08_24_acelab_x_structured_ai_h.summary: Gary's Guide: Join Acelab & Structured AI for an evening of building, food, & drinks. On any project the drawings, specs, & material library all disagree with each other in small ways. A door spec'd at a 90-minute fire rating that's scheduled at 60. A product still sitting in the specs years after its certification lapsed. Someone either catches these by reading everything twice, or nobody does. We're opening up Structured's document parsing & Acelab's material search for the night so you can take a run at automating it. Everyone gets the same package with a set of known errors planted in it, & we score what you build against ground truth at the end.

gary_2026_08_25_tech_x_market_decoders_t.title: Tech x Market Decoders (This week's topic - Anthropic's IPO)
gary_2026_08_25_tech_x_market_decoders_t.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_08_25_tech_x_market_decoders_t.summary: Gary's Guide: We decode tech & market signals together - so you can operate, invest, & decide better. AI can build a financial model, summarize an earnings call, or map a competitive landscape in seconds. What it can't do is connect the dots around a technology, a trend, a business, an idea, a decision. That takes human judgment, experience, & taste. The kind you only build by studying real examples, arguing them out loud, & testing your read against people who see it differently than you do. That's what Tech x Market Decoders is for. Every week, we pick one topic - a company or startup everyone's talking about, a technology reshaping an industry, or a shift in how things are being built or bought. Bring your laptop. Here's how it works: 15-20 minutes - decode solo. Quiet research time. Dig into the news, the product, the tech stack, the data. No talking, just thinking. 35-40 minutes - decode together. We open the floor. What did you find? Where do you disagree? What's convincing, what's overhyped, what would change your mind? This is where judgment actually gets built - not from reading alone, but from testing your read against someone else's. Last few minutes - wrap up. This week's topic: Anthropic's upcoming IPO Anthropic filed confidentially for one of the most anticipated debuts in years, with a listing expected in Sept/Oct 2026. We're decoding the business behind Claude; the revenue growth, the compute costs, & whether the valuation actually holds up once Wall Street gets a look. Come as you are - operator, investor, builder, or just someone who reads too much tech or business news & wants to discuss with smart people.

gary_2026_08_26_hard_negatives_ai_enggrs.summary: Gary's Guide: Join the AI debate night where you defend the take you'd never post online. RAG is dead. AI is already sentient. Open weights should be banned. We should trust models we can't explain. Think you can argue either side? Find a partner & sign up as a team. At the event, you'll draw a controversial AI take at random. Your team gets 3 minutes to prepare & 10 minutes to make the case. You don't choose the position. You have to sell it. The room votes live. The strongest arguments win prizes. First prize: Surprise Lego sets Second prize: Qdrant hoodies Third prize: Surprise TBA Teams of 2, each person receives a prize Additional prizes to be announced Both members of every winning team receive a prize. Not feeling argumentative? Come watch the debates, play games, grab a drink, & enjoy the spectacle from a safe distance. Your RSVP includes: one drink ticket (beer, wine, classic cocktail or well drink) for the first 150 people to arrive Small bites & appetizers Unlimited pool tables, darts, foosball , ping pong & shuffleboard tables Built for engineers, AI researchers, & builders in New York City, especially anyone working on search, retrieval, or agents. Check-in begins at 6:30 PM. Debates start at 7:00 PM. Spots are limited, & registration approval is required. This is a 21+ event. By registering, you agree to receive event emails & consent to being photographed at the event.

gary_2026_09_03_investors_for_a_better_a.summary: Gary's Guide: A nonpartisan conference for family offices & other investors strengthening our capitalist constitutional democracy. Our speakers are senior investors from Millennium, Apogem, Rothschild Asset Management, Harvard Management Company, Goldman Sachs, B Capital, First Round, Renaissance Technologies, District of Columbia Retirement, International Finance Corporation, Cantor Fitzgerald, & TIAA-CREF. We believe a free & fair democracy is foundational to a strong investment climate. Free enterprise depends on civic conditions that markets cannot create on their own, including: - Representative & accountable democracy without over-centralization & with anti-corruption safeguards - Social trust - A responsive, fiscally responsible, & effective government with an independent Federal Reserve - The ability to recruit the best people globally, and - Strong alliances, especially with other capitalist democracies. Who: investors, philanthropists, nonprofits, senior executives, founders Cost: Admission is complimentary for investing principals of family offices, foundations, endowments, & other institutional investors with at least $100m AUM, who do not manage outside capital. All others: $2,026. Use 10% discount code: IBA_Cal_2026. All revenues go to Mediators Foundation, a 501(c)3 nonprofit focused on bridging divides.

gary_2026_09_10_same_team_triple_the_vol.summary: Gary's Guide: A working session for eCommerce operators. Get your holiday AI stack sorted before Q4. Hosted by Streamline Agency with Gorgias, Retell AI, & Backstroke. Get a clear, practical read on where AI belongs in their BFCM stack, from creative production through operations & support, before Q4 locks & there is no time left to change anything. Sit with brands using AI to scale revenue & team capacity through peak season, & with the platform teams behind those tools. Creative production, operations, retention, & support, all in one morning. No decks. No 40 minute conference talks. Come with questions & your actual stack in mind. What you leave with Real AI use cases running inside real brands, not roadmap slides Direct conversation with the platform teams & with peers already running the setup A read on the specific gap in your stack while there is still time to close it A short list of what to test in September, & what to leave alone until January Masterclass Sessions: CX & Support. Gorgias, with a brand walking through the workflow they will actually run on Black Friday. Where AI resolution ends & a human has to take over. Voice & Intake. Retell AI on capturing after hours & overflow calls & turning them into structured records something downstream can act on. Retention & Lifecycle. Backstroke on AI generated campaigns & segmentation that stay on brand when send volume spikes. Integration & Automation. n8n on the plumbing between all of it, & what happens when a step fails at 2am on Cyber Monday. Who this is for Built for eCommerce & D2C brands doing roughly $20M to $200M, & specifically for the people who feel peak season in their day: COO & VP Operations VP & Director of eCommerce or Digital Head or Director of Customer Experience & Support Director of Retention, Lifecycle, or CRM Business Operations & Ops Tech leads Founders at the earlier end of that range If you are the person currently holding your stack together with manual exports & good intentions, this room is for you. Who we are Streamline Agency builds the integration layer between the tools eCommerce brands already own. Certified n8n & Anthropic Claude partner.

jc_culture_10003565_2026_08_26_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.title: The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) 91st Annual Members Exhibition 2026
jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.label: Art / Culture
jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.place: MANA CONTEMPORARY, 888 NEWARK AVE., JERSEY CITY
jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.summary: 91st Annual Members Exhibition The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) is excited to announce its upcoming 91st Annual Members Exhibition, to be held at Mana Contemporary in Jersey City from September 11–27, 2026 (Fridays and Saturdays, 3:00–7:00 PM; Sundays, 12:00–3:00 PM). The exhibition will feature 200 hand-pulled prints representing a broad range of printmaking techniques and subjects, created by SAGA artists from across the country. Awards will be juried by Leslie Diuguid, founder of Du-Good Press in Brooklyn. The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) is a nonprofit organization established in 1915 whose mission is to promote contemporary printmakers, cultivate printmaking appreciation and education, and provide a collaborative and inclusive platform for artists across the country. https://sagaprints.com/ Hosting this year’s exhibition is Monira Foundation, an independent nonprofit institution that functions as a radical experimental laboratory, working in close collaboration with artists, curators, musicians, dancers, producers, and writers to conceive, realize, and present innovative projects in all media. Monira is located within Mana Contemporary, a 2-million-square-foot art center. The complex occupies a renovated 100-year-old former tobacco warehouse, featuring expansive exhibition spaces, working artist studios, the International Center of Photography archives, and more. A free public reception and awards ceremony with participating artists will be held on Saturday, September 26, from 3:00–5:00 PM. Guests are invited to enjoy light refreshments while celebrating the diversity and innovation of contemporary printmaking. WHEN Exhibition: Fridays–Sundays, September 11–27, 2026 Public Reception & Awards Ceremony: Saturday, September 26, 2026 3:00–5:00 PM WHERE Mana Contemporary 888 Newark Avenue Jersey City, NJ 07306

jc_culture_10003568_2026_09_16_hamilton_.label: Festival / Market
jc_culture_10003568_2026_09_16_hamilton_.place: Hamilton Park, 9 McWilliams Pl., Jersey City, NJ
jc_culture_10003568_2026_09_16_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

jc_culture_10004820_2026_09_18_the_socie.title: The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) 91st Annual Members Exhibition 2026
jc_culture_10004820_2026_09_18_the_socie.label: Art / Culture
jc_culture_10004820_2026_09_18_the_socie.place: MANA CONTEMPORARY, 888 NEWARK AVE., JERSEY CITY
jc_culture_10004820_2026_09_18_the_socie.summary: 91st Annual Members Exhibition The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) is excited to announce its upcoming 91st Annual Members Exhibition, to be held at Mana Contemporary in Jersey City from September 11–27, 2026 (Fridays and Saturdays, 3:00–7:00 PM; Sundays, 12:00–3:00 PM). The exhibition will feature 200 hand-pulled prints representing a broad range of printmaking techniques and subjects, created by SAGA artists from across the country. Awards will be juried by Leslie Diuguid, founder of Du-Good Press in Brooklyn. The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) is a nonprofit organization established in 1915 whose mission is to promote contemporary printmakers, cultivate printmaking appreciation and education, and provide a collaborative and inclusive platform for artists across the country. https://sagaprints.com/ Hosting this year’s exhibition is Monira Foundation, an independent nonprofit institution that functions as a radical experimental laboratory, working in close collaboration with artists, curators, musicians, dancers, producers, and writers to conceive, realize, and present innovative projects in all media. Monira is located within Mana Contemporary, a 2-million-square-foot art center. The complex occupies a renovated 100-year-old former tobacco warehouse, featuring expansive exhibition spaces, working artist studios, the International Center of Photography archives, and more. A free public reception and awards ceremony with participating artists will be held on Saturday, September 26, from 3:00–5:00 PM. Guests are invited to enjoy light refreshments while celebrating the diversity and innovation of contemporary printmaking. WHEN Exhibition: Fridays–Sundays, September 11–27, 2026 Public Reception & Awards Ceremony: Saturday, September 26, 2026 3:00–5:00 PM WHERE Mana Contemporary 888 Newark Avenue Jersey City, NJ 07306

jc_culture_10004827_2026_09_24_rent_the_.title: RENT: The Musical
jc_culture_10004827_2026_09_24_rent_the_.label: Music / Movies
jc_culture_10004827_2026_09_24_rent_the_.place: ART HOUSE, 345 MARIN BLVD, JERSEY CITY
jc_culture_10004827_2026_09_24_rent_the_.summary: Experience the groundbreaking Tony Award-winning musical and Pulitzer Prize-winning drama that defined a generation. Presented at Art House Productions during the 30th anniversary year of its original premiere, RENT follows a vibrant community of artists, musicians, and dreamers in New York City’s East Village as they pursue their passions, navigate love and loss, and strive to make a meaningful impact on the world around them. Set against the backdrop of the AIDS crisis, poverty, addiction, economic uncertainty, and a rapidly changing city, these artists discover the power of friendship, the importance of creative expression, and the enduring strength of community. Featuring iconic songs and an unforgettable rock score, RENT celebrates resilience, human connection, and the transformative role of the arts in times of hardship. This production is especially meaningful as part of Art House Productions’ 25th Anniversary Season. Founded in the wake of September 11, 2001, Art House was created to bring people together through the arts during a time of profound loss and uncertainty. Thirty years after its premiere, RENT remains as relevant, timeless, and inspiring as ever, reminding us all to measure our lives in love.
